culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: At the Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew, banned clothing includes sleeveless shirts, vests, short or see-through tops, shorts, torn or tight pants, bike pants, mini skirts, pant-skirts and sleepwear.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: No drones. Open daily 8:30am to 4:30pm, with tickets sold until 3:30pm; ticket ฿500 (about A$21.08 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026).
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Bureau of the Royal Household (Grand Palace).

festivals.what: Songkran 2026 in Bangkok: the main public events ran within or close to the national 13 to 15 April holiday, including Songkran on Silom Road 12 to 14 April, the Amazing Bangkok Songkran Parade on Silom Road on 14 April, the Maha Songkran World Event at Benjakitti Park 11 to 15 April, the Bangkok Water Festival at ten sites 13 to 15 April, and Siam Songkran at Siam Square 12 to 15 April.

protocol_notes: Siam Square runs a no alcohol, no powder policy during Songkran (TAT, April 2026).
